notes.note: The BOM table is misplaced under C.6.2; it belongs to remove_bom (Table C.2, C.5.8). BOM-table tests (C.06.02_test_003..016) are therefore expressed via remove_bom/oct2unichar/get_stringencoding.
'Not required / no effect' tested as: UTF-8 is identified without BOM and decoding with the BOM removed equals decoding without BOM.
Reading 1 chosen: with UTF-16BE a leading FE FF is not a signature, so oct2unichar decodes it as U+FEFF (ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE).
Reading 1 chosen: with UTF-16LE a leading FF FE is decoded by oct2unichar as U+FEFF.
Reading 1 chosen: with UTF-32BE a leading 00 00 FE FF is decoded by oct2unichar as U+FEFF.
Reading 1 chosen: with UTF-32LE a leading FF FE 00 00 is decoded by oct2unichar as U+FEFF.
Tests one general error cause of 16.1.2: wrong number of actual parameters (testcasename(1)).

Reading 'any address of the executing host' chosen; the test only checks that MTC and control obtain a well-formed IPv4 address (assumes the host has one, e.g. 127.0.0.1); the actual value cannot be verified without a SUT.
Only the format is checked (IPv4 dotted form, IPv6 containing ':'), empty string allowed when no address of the kind is available.
Tests the three predefined values and the Ipv4orIPv6 fallback rule; the behaviour for non-predefined values (ambiguous) is not tested.
Tests one general error cause of 16.1.2: actual parameter of wrong type (hostid(4)).
Reading 1 chosen: macro not replaced inside a literal pattern string.
Replacement inside comments is not directly observable; the test only checks that macros in comments are harmless and do not affect line counting.
Canonical file name format is OS dependent; the test checks that __FILE__ contains a path prefix, the directory name and the basic file name.
